text_block_list.text:
"...The new year has begun.
Starting this year, <chrname> is in the Senior Class."

"On the track, despite it being early morning,
the members of 'Project L'Arc'
were already putting in running laps."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year,
<username> Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I heard a rumor. Did a TV station offer you a gig as a commentator as the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe winner?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: So you're saying she turned it down.
choice_data_list: Yes, because it was a program on the day of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's wise.
If you accept the offer, you won't be able to challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe this year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Are you aiming for back-to-back victories?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I'll warn you now—it's a steep and rugged path.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The European contingent will be desperate to reclaim their crown
and will surely mark you closely.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: And it won't just be the marking that gets tougher.

—I understood what it was
that she was concerned about.
"Right after the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe victory, only positive opinions could be found, but as time passed, a wide variety of voices surfaced online."

"Her victory this time was just lucky."
"She won't be able to pull it off next time."
"Is there even any point in aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe anymore?"

"...If <chrname> were to lose,
I wonder what kind of feedback we'd receive."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, do you still intend
to aim for victory once more?”
choice_data_list: I won't let anyone call our victory a fluke.
I won't let anyone call our victory a fluke.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: There might be heartless voices online. But I know the truth. Your strength is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And—I am truly proud
of your challenge from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the project will kick off the
"Representative Inter-League Match" starting late March.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: And so, until then, I want you to build up your body and prepare for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...It seems you are already doing so, though!
